name: Anocitius
text: Anocitius is a British god of the Roman time. His cult appears at the fort of Condercum, near the town of Benwell on the Roman wall. His head bears a shape that suggests a stag in the carving that survives. His images belong to the young men of the shrine.

attributes.attribute: British god honoured at Condercum on the Roman wall

okr.objective: Record the local British god Anocitius.
key_results: Note the stag-like form of his head.
